environment.description: Same Django REST API on ECS Fargate. LaunchDarkly flag 'webhook-proxy-dns-pinning' targeting rule configured with percentage rollout: 100% TRUE for context attribute 'tenant_id' matching regex '.*' with fallthrough variation index 0 (true). Flag environment is 'production' with prerequisite flag 'enable-ssrf-mitigations' also ON. Client-side SDK initialization uses streaming mode with 50ms polling fallback. The flag evaluation returns True for all contexts, routing all traffic through fetch_url_with_rebind_protection() which pins DNS resolution. Note: the LD relay proxy is deployed as a sidecar in the same task definition ensuring sub-millisecond flag evaluation latency with no network dependency on LD cloud for flag reads.

config.launchdarkly_flag_webhook-proxy-dns-pinn: ON - 100% rollout, all contexts evaluate to true, prerequisite 'enable-ssrf-mitigations' also ON
config.launchdarkly_relay_proxy: sidecar in ECS task definition, persistent streaming connection, local flag store in DynamoDB with 0 TTL eviction
config.flag_fallback_behavior: SDK default value is False BUT relay proxy guarantees flag availability; SDK configured with offline: false
